<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-reference.mjs. Edit the repository definition and its Markdown documentation. -->

Bootstrap an Alpine Linux root filesystem.

## Inputs

No artifact inputs.

## Parameters

| Name      | Default      | Description                                                                  |
| --------- | ------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `version` | **Required** | Alpine release series, such as 3.20. The recipe downloads its .0 minirootfs. |

## Scheduling

| Setting      | Value         |
| ------------ | ------------- |
| Priority     | `10000000`    |
| Dependencies | `pkg-cleanup` |

Higher priorities run first within the selected recipe set. Dependencies include
other recipes; their priorities determine execution order.

## Behavior

Use this recipe in a root layer. It downloads and extracts an Alpine minirootfs
for the target architecture, then configures DNS. Supported architectures are
amd64, arm64, armv7, and armhf.

## Example

For example, add the recipe to a root layer (set `root = true` instead of a
parent):

```toml title="layers/base.toml"
root = true
recipes = ["core/alpine-bootstrap"]

[parameters."core/alpine-bootstrap"]
version = "3.20"
```
